title: Require Service Module Isolation
forbids: service-root execution imports from module interiors, module re-exports, relative paths that cross a module root, raw base acquisition outside module middleware, impl acquisition outside module.ts or owning module middleware, and sibling-module entry through the current owner's private alias
why: Service roots compose contracts and operation trees while each module owns one sealed subdomain interior. Habitat owns that containment boundary; contract, context, and router laws own executable direction inside it.
remediate: Keep ordinary collaboration inside the owning module. Cross to service base or impl only at their declared module boundaries, compose module contracts and routers only at the service root, and move sibling collaboration behind an intentional service-level interface.
message: Service roots compose modules; modules own their implementation and do not enter siblings.
